decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 dsh web host as the koffi.node holder, cites running-processes.txt and attempt1-ebusy.log copyfile EBUSY, and explains the loaded .node binary stays in use until the host exits.

Explicitly explains a refresh only reloads the SPA while the host keeps the module mapped, and gives an ordered numbered procedure: stop all dsh processes and verify via tasklist, install, then restart and verify.

Grounded in npm-dist-tags.txt: bare name resolves to latest (0.1.1-rc.2), alpha tag holds 0.1.2-alpha.5, and explains the silent downgrade from alpha.4; correctly notes npm ignores the installed version.

Provides the exact pinned npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 and a dsh-tui install after stopping the host, verifies dsh --version prints 0.1.2-alpha.5, and restarts; @alpha is only offered as a noted alternative.

Advises README authors to pin the exact intended version, never a bare name following latest, state the peer corridor, and use separately pinned or fully pinned combined commands; no reliance on BAD examples.
